resources.string: Contains a one-time secret. It is hidden and never logged.
Scanning is offline. Camera access is requested only when you scan; file import and JSON paste do not need it.
Camera preview for the invitation QR code
Keep the entire QR code inside the frame. The camera closes after a scan; you will review the computer identity before connecting.
The camera reads the invitation shown on your own computer. Images are processed only on this phone, never saved or sent. You can import a file or paste JSON instead.
Camera access is disabled. Allow it in this app’s system settings to scan, or import the invitation file or paste JSON without camera access.
Camera access was not granted. You can try scanning again, import the invitation file, or paste JSON.
No camera is available on this device. Import the invitation file or paste JSON instead.
Could not start the camera. Close other camera apps and try again, or import the invitation file or paste JSON.

Tasks and provider credentials stay on your computer. Use an invitation from your own trusted computer, not from an unknown link. The fingerprint only protects a connection when the invitation itself is trusted.
The invitation requests a connection to:
This invitation includes a local certificate trust anchor. Its identity, hostname, validity and public-key pin will be verified.
Compare the address and fingerprint with the invitation shown on your computer before connecting. There is no option to bypass certificate checks.
Unencrypted loopback transport: development builds only, through adb reverse. Not for remote use.
Read-only project. Sending and stopping tasks are unavailable.
This chat is ready. Write a task below to get started.
Showing the last received state. The task may still be running on your computer.
Remove this connection in settings, then create a new invitation on your computer.
Update the phone app or host plugin to compatible versions. Tasks remain on your computer.
Demo host — synthetic content, not connected to DSH.
This task needs attention on your computer. Questions and approvals cannot be answered on the phone yet.
Task status could not be confirmed. Check it on your computer; sending is disabled.
Three messages in this chat are awaiting history. Refresh or dismiss a local entry to send another.
Dismissing removes only this phone’s entry. It does not cancel or remove anything on the computer.
The computer already accepted this message and may still process it. Sending again creates a new command and may duplicate the message. Send again anyway?
Draft stays on this phone. It will not send automatically when reconnected.
Waiting for the computer to confirm delivery.
Accepted by the computer. Refreshing the conversation.
The computer rejected this command. Check its receipt before continuing.
Delivery is uncertain. Do not send again: the task may already have started.
Delivery status is unknown. Check the original command.
A stop request will be sent to your computer. The task is not stopped until the computer confirms its status.
Stop request accepted. Waiting for the computer to confirm the task has stopped.
Showing the latest messages. Open your computer for earlier history.
Live response — not yet saved by the computer
No project allows task execution. Ask the host owner to grant access.
Projects match DSH on your computer.
Background notifications are not available yet. Tasks continue on your computer; reopen the app to sync their results.
Attachments, structured questions and approvals are not supported in this version. Use your computer for these actions.
Local removal does not revoke this device on your computer and does not stop its tasks. To revoke access, use the host device settings.
The connection credential, drafts and pending receipts will be removed from this phone. An uncertain task may still run on your computer. Check it there before pairing again.
The invitation is invalid. Import the complete invitation JSON created on your computer.
Could not read this invitation file. Choose a UTF-8 JSON file smaller than 64 KB, or paste its contents.
This connection address is not allowed. Use a valid HTTPS invitation.
The invitation is missing a valid public-key pin. Create a new invitation on your computer.
The invitation certificate is invalid. Create a new invitation with a valid host certificate.
Could not pair. The invitation may have expired or already been used. If the pairing response was lost, check and revoke the possible device on your computer, then create a new invitation.
The computer did not authorize this connection. Check access there and pair again if needed.
This device was revoked. Remove the local connection and pair with a new invitation.
This project or action is not allowed for this phone. Check permissions on your computer.
The host protocol is incompatible. Update the app or host plugin.
This action is not supported by the computer. Continue on the computer.
The computer returned an invalid response. Reconnect; if it persists, check the host plugin.

Could not reach your computer. Make sure it is on and DSH is running, check the internet connection, then reconnect. The connection may also be unavailable at the relay; the app cannot confirm the cause.
Could not verify the computer certificate. Check its certificate, address and invitation. Verification cannot be bypassed.
Too many requests. Wait a moment before reconnecting.
The computer could not complete this request. Check the host and refresh the connection.
Could not securely save phone state. Do not resend an uncertain task; check it on your computer.
Connect your computer with an invitation first.
Sending while offline is unavailable. Your draft will not send automatically.
A previous command is unresolved. Check its delivery before sending another.
The command may have reached your computer. Check delivery; do not resend.
The computer rejected the command. Check its receipt and permissions.
The original command identity conflicts with its payload. Do not resend; check it on your computer.
Enter a non-empty message no larger than 32 KB.
Choose an available executable project and host preset.
The request could not be completed. Check the connection and task status on your computer before trying again.
History is not available while disconnected. Reconnect to load the current conversation from your computer.
Checked the task on your computer?
The task may have been accepted. This will not stop it or send the message again. Check the chat on your computer first; the local draft and delivery warning will be cleared.
Showing the latest 1000 chats. Remaining chats are available on your computer.
Some details are not available on the phone yet. Open the chat on your computer if needed.
Invitation loaded. Review the computer identity before connecting.
After this trusted pairing, the app connects automatically through this relay. No separate phone VPN app is needed. The computer identity is still verified using its certificate fingerprint.
Your computer must be on, connected to the internet and running DSH. This app cannot wake an offline computer.
The latest state is loaded from your computer. Tasks keep running when you leave the app.
Try another title or clear the search.
Start a task in this project. Its conversation will appear here.
Create a chat in one of your computer’s projects.
No messages were loaded. Return to the list to choose another chat or refresh.
Long message: showing a bounded preview. Copy the message for its full text.
Agent is working · less than a minute
Waiting for an answer on the computer
Create an invitation in DSH on your computer.
Scan the QR code on your computer, or transfer the invitation file.
Check the computer identity and connect.
Chats, projects and tasks — with you. Execution stays on your computer.
Computer name is available after secure pairing.
